epics.title: Identity, profiles, and role-governed access
epics.objective: Provide authenticated identities and approved access boundaries for recruits, managers, and admins.
epics.business_value: Protects onboarding information while enabling each role's stated work.
dependencies: Approval of Q-002 through Q-005 and Q-010
completion_criteria: All E001 stories meet their acceptance criteria
A complete role matrix is approved and tested
No protected operation lacks an authorization test

epics.title: Recruit onboarding diary
epics.objective: Allow recruits to capture and retrieve tasks, issues, feedback, and notes.
epics.business_value: Creates the primary record of the recruit's onboarding journey.
exclusions: Search, attachments, comments, sharing, and unapproved lifecycle operations
completion_criteria: All four diary record types meet approved lifecycle and validation criteria
Ownership and role restrictions are verified

epics.title: Onboarding dashboard
epics.objective: Present approved summary counts, recent activity, task progress, and open issues.
epics.business_value: Gives users an at-a-glance view of onboarding activity and blockers.
exclusions: Unapproved charts, trends, goals, or analytics
completion_criteria: Calculations and visibility scope are approved
Seeded boundary cases produce verified dashboard results

epics.title: Authorized downloadable reporting
epics.objective: Generate date-range diary reports in PDF and CSV for authorized users.
epics.business_value: Allows managers to review and share onboarding records for recruits they oversee.
scope: Task, issue, feedback, and combined reports
completion_criteria: Each report type is content-verified in both formats
Unauthorized and out-of-scope downloads are denied

epics.title: Simple platform, responsive UX, and failure behavior
epics.objective: Establish the mandated stack and approved cross-cutting data, responsiveness, validation, and recovery behavior.
epics.business_value: Makes the application runnable, usable, and independently evaluable without unnecessary infrastructure.
completion_criteria: Data lifetime is documented and tested
Approved viewport and negative scenarios pass

epics.title: Approved extension features
epics.objective: Deliver exactly the additional feature scope approved for the exercise.
epics.business_value: Satisfies the BRD extension instruction without introducing unapproved scope.
exclusions: Any feature not explicitly selected and approved
completion_criteria: Two selected features have requirement, story, acceptance, and verification detail
